main.description: Something a person does to keep a place going, added to the Atlas of Care. It lives in its author's repo and is placed in an administrative unit, not at an address.

atlas.description: The atlas this entry is for. The backlink index finds entries by this field.

pays.description: Who pays, or that nobody does.

mode.description: repeats: has to be done again. turns: a bounded act that changes what follows.

scope.description: Which of the atlas's maps the unit belongs to.

unit.description: The unit's id on that map: ISO alpha-3 country, US county FIPS, geoBoundaries shape id, or NUTS-2 code.

lat.description: Latitude of the unit's centre, as a decimal string with two places.

lon.description: Longitude of the unit's centre, as a decimal string with two places.
